Quick summary:
- Currently running Llama-2 13B (quantized) on EC2 instances. Ops overhead high, monthly spend unpredictable.
- Wants hosted API that behaves like a drop-in: minimal prompt surgery and similar/superior quality.
- Primary workloads: customer chat (short prompts, history), product embeddings for search and reranking (batch index + online similarity), light code/templating for responses.
- Traffic profile: steady 2-3 rps, peak ~8 rps during promotions. Latency target: 200-500ms p50 for chat, p95 <= 1s preferred. Cost sensitivity: high (SMB), target < $0.05 per 1k tokens across avg workload if feasible.

- Qwen variants: interest in Qwen-7B for instruction-following; want clarity on embeddings compatibility and whether Qwen embeddings match their reranking quality.
- Re-routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to cheaper model during bursts; asked how Redwood routing policies and model-variant compatibility work.
- Eval UX: asked for quick A/B with 50 prompts (we promised sample eval harness + cost per 1k tokens scenarios).

Security/compliance: SMB but have enterprise customers; require SSO (SAML), basic audit logs, and optional retention controls. Residency: prefer NA region for latency.

POC ask: 2-week validation using hosted_api; provide 50 chat prompts + 200 embedding vectors; judge relevance and hallucination. If POC acceptable, convert to paid self-serve plan, then evaluate Dedicated later.
